system.description:
Action
Ritual · 8 hours
SP
8
Attribute
None
Range
One unattended mundane handheld item; 200 coins of enchanting materials consumed
Duration
Until dismissed, unraveled or replaced

Bind one known Main Action or Maneuver spell costing 1–5 SP into the item. Its bearer may release that spell once between your safe overnight rests, using the spell’s stated action and attribute, with the bearer’s attribute value and position. The release costs 0 SP; all other casting requirements, materials and costs apply. The bearer handles any Sustain or commands. Choose a spell from outside Channeling that neither restores or transfers SP nor enchants another item. You keep one imbued item. Completing another ends the previous enchantment without renewing its used release; all your replacements share that allowance. Your normal safe overnight rest renews the allowance once per 24 hours.
